name: Isle of Wight Foodbank (Cowes)
short_description: Part of The Trussell Trust network providing emergency food parcels. Based at Cowes Community Centre. Open Tue and Thu for distribution. Referral required.

name: Isle of Wight Council Allotments
short_description: Isle of Wight Council allotment sites in Cowes area
description: Council manages sites at Park Road and Cross Lane. Plots from £35/year. Waiting lists operate. Island maritime climate suitable for early crops.

name: Cowes Community Garden
description: Volunteer-run community garden within Northwood Park. Grows vegetables and herbs with harvest shared among volunteers. Coastal location suitable for early season growing.
